cloud_model.description: Gemini model for cloud extraction and the explanation

cloud_model_fallback.description: Tried once when cloud_model is still busy (500/503, or a per-minute 429) after its retries; never after a daily-limit 429. Empty turns the fallback off

prompt_version.description: Explanation prompt version, shown under each explanation

hindi_enabled.description: Offer the Hindi translation of the explanation

path3_enabled.description: Show Path 3 (send the full report with consent). Paused (false) while the Gemini API is on the free tier
